**Combined #220/#221 after-deploy reading complete** on `fee5f6d342536f987b7f75eb04356b26e36cd82d`, healthy **PID49638**, process start **10 Nov 16:41:16 +10:00**. This one observation covers their shared deployment, not two isolated feature measurements.

Window: **16:48:26.576640 to16:53:26.586408 +10:00**, **300.009155 monotonic seconds**. Bracketing build/PID, process start and all site sums/deltas reconcile. The capture finished and its bounce hold was released.

| Metric | PID45657 baseline | PID45657 hour | PID49638 current |
|---|---|---|---|
| Parent CPU |32.63% |32.97% |**28.88%**,86.64 CPU seconds |
| Launches /300s |188 |173 |**233**,0.7766/s |
| Native-process ps |118 |120 |**122** |
| Completed holder-current ps |114 |120 |**120** |
| RSS, MiB |119.969 to116.375 |140.922 to142.750 |**181.172 to191.453** |
| Machine sampled lower bound /s |318.2 |290.4 |**263.9** |

Current cumulative CPU advances **2:17.57 to3:44.21**; RSS **185,520 to196,048KiB**, **+10,528KiB**. CPU is4.09 percentage points below the preceding PID45657 hour window even with more daemon launches. This is a different build/incarnation, age and workload, **not proof that either fix caused a CPU reduction or memory change**. The prior five-minute windows also included their authorized10s profiler; this one did not.

**Current launches by site:** `ps.registration-native-process`122; `git.community`77; `ddocs.community`22; `git.pa-watchdog-common-dir`2; `sh.background-job`3; `tmux.rename-window`4; `tmux.new-window`1; `tmux.pipe-pane attach`1; `tmux.set-options tap owner`1. All other sites flat. Community git/ddocs rose from45 combined launches in the old hour window to99 here.

The lease-retry component stays at **60 attempts/120 ps per five minutes**: viper, stoat and worthwhile-sole each20 attempts/40 ps. Another explicit rebound contributes2 ps; registration tallies reconcile with the122 site total here. F162's launch source remains present; this is not #222's after-deploy proof.

**Machine sample:**16:48:26 to16:53:26,300s,2,793,588 polls. Observed lower-bound attribution:175.5/s gone before seen,87.7/s other, about0.8/s recognized direct daemon children. The raw endpoint estimate275.6/s is not a validated full-window total because the PID estimator is wrap-ambiguous over300s. No causal whole-host rate comparison is claimed. Load averages are50.33 to56.70, and sampling itself costs CPU.

No real close, pane action, synthetic invocation of either changed path, model operation, local product build/test or live settings/transcript/credential read. No additional stack sample was taken. These are normal deployed-fleet readings; the shared observation closes the requested rollout readings for **both #220 and #221**, not their per-operation benchmarks or #213/#155 traffic proof.

Comparison anchors: baseline output99e92286 and paired deliverable115ba874. Receipts: `pr220-221-pid49638-after-window.json`, bracketing pings, machine JSON/times and `pr220-221-pid49638-summary.json`.
